_note: Semiconductor export-control regimes relevant to the topology. Compiled from public policy through early 2026 — verify against current BIS/METI/EU announcements before relying on dates in research output.

instruments.name: Advanced computing & semiconductor manufacturing controls
instruments.summary: License requirements on advanced-node logic/memory equipment and high-end AI accelerators to China; US-person restrictions; foreign direct product rules.

instruments.name: Performance-density update
instruments.summary: Closed A800/H800-class workarounds; tightened compute-density thresholds; country-scope widened.

instruments.name: HBM & SME expansion
instruments.summary: Controls on HBM exports and 24 additional semiconductor-manufacturing-equipment types; entity-list additions across the Chinese toolchain.

instruments.name: Advanced DUV licensing
instruments.summary: License requirement for advanced immersion DUV lithography (NXT:2000i and above). EUV has never shipped to China.

instruments.name: 23-category SME licensing
instruments.summary: Export licensing for 23 categories of semiconductor manufacturing equipment: lithography, deposition, etch, cleaning, inspection.

instruments.name: Advanced-node foundry restrictions
instruments.summary: Foundry services at advanced nodes restricted for Chinese AI-chip designers following diversion findings; strategic high-tech commodity list alignment.

instruments.name: Multilateral alignment
instruments.summary: Alignment with US-led controls; VEU carve-outs govern Samsung/SK Hynix fabs operating in China.

instruments.name: Gallium & germanium permits
instruments.summary: Export permits required for Ga/Ge — inputs to power semiconductors and optics.

instruments.name: Dual-use ban to US
instruments.summary: Ban on gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard-material exports to the US; stricter graphite review.

instruments.name: Heavy rare-earth controls
instruments.summary: Export controls on seven heavy rare-earth elements and magnets — upstream of motors, optics, and power systems.
